answer: An agent earns voting weight only after locking a fixed bond in an epoch escrow, and each seat is tied to a verified funding root. A public pigment tag links deposits from the same root; coordinated duplicate seats are audited and their bonds slashed. A Sybil attacker must fund and freeze one full bond per identity for a voyage of epochs, so cloning keys multiplies real capital at risk. A saffron reserve cannot make that cost disappear.
